content.text: Follow the severe condition schedule if vehicle is operated mainly under one or more of the following severe conditions:

items: Towing a trailer, using a camper or car top carrier.
Operating on dusty, rough, muddy or salt spread roads.
Repeat short trips less than 5 miles (8 km) and outside temperatures remain below freezing.
Extensive idling such as police, taxi or door-to-door delivery use.
